title: Crash occurs when Debug Log Path is set to a custom path
body:
### Tested versions

Does not reproduce:
- v4.2.1.stable.mono.official [b09f793f5]
- v4.4.stable.mono.official [4c311cbee]

Reproduces:
- v4.5.stable.mono.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable.mono - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 62.71 GiB memory

### Issue description

Crash occurs when running project after changing the Project Settings>Debug > File Logging > Log Path to a path that does not have godot.log at the end of a custom path string. 

Tested Examples:
user://logs/godot  -> runs
user://logs/godot/ -> runs
user://logs/banana/godot/ -> runs
user://logs/banana/godot.logs -> runs
user://logs/godot. -> runs
user://banana/godot.log -> crashes
/home/michaelgooch/GameDev/Godot/godot.log -> runs
/home/michaelgooch/GameDev/Godot/ -> crashes
/home/michaelgooch/GameDev/Godot/banana -> runs
/home/michaelgooch/GameDev/Godot/logs -> crashes
/home/michaelgooch/GameDev/Godot/logs/godot.log -> runs

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project
2. Enter Project Settings>Debug > File Logging  and change the Log Path to a custom patch
3. Enable File Logging
4. Make a new scene with any node
5. Run the project
